title: Watch: Barcelona star’s bemused reaction to claims Lamine Yamal will miss UCL clash to play GTA
snippet: Barcelona star Frenkie de Jong was left looking nothing short of baffled, owing to a question posed to him regarding teammate Lamine Yamal during an appearance in front of the…
body: Barcelona star Frenkie de Jong was left looking nothing short of baffled, owing to a question posed to him regarding teammate Lamine Yamal during an appearance in front of the media on Tuesday. Winger Lamine is for his part set to miss out for Barcelona for the first time this season on Wednesday night, when the Blaugrana make the trip to Baku to lock horns with Sabah in the Champions League. The 19-year-old is dealing with a minor ankle issue, which requires further treatment in Catalunya’s capital. The problem just so happens to coincide with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, the most highly anticipated video game of the last decade. Lamine, a self-proclaimed gamer, has for his part already taken to social media, to confirm that he has secured a copy of the game. After joining manager Hansi Flick for a pre-match press conference on Tuesday, Barcelona star Frenkie de Jong was therefore asked by one reporter in attendance whether his young teammate’s absence for tomorrow night could be attributed to GTA’s release. And De Jong’s reaction was one perfectly befitting of such a bizarre question: Before leaving the room, a journalist from Azerbaijan asked Frenkie whether Lamine was missing the game because of GTA 6. Frenkie's reaction: 😭 pic.twitter.com/LM20q3rZRo Conor Laird – GSFN
summary_en: Lamine Yamal will miss Barcelona's Champions League game at Sabah with a minor ankle problem, prompting an odd media question to De Jong.

title: ‘It’s not our style’ – PSG manager Luis Enrique rejects making a stop-gap winter signing in the wake of Désiré Doué’s serious injury
snippet: PSG manager Luis Enrique believes that Les Parisiens have no obligation to dip into the transfer market this winter as the back-to-back UEFA Champions League winners’ attack looks depleted on…
body: PSG manager Luis Enrique believes that Les Parisiens have no obligation to dip into the transfer market this winter as the back-to-back UEFA Champions League winners’ attack looks depleted on the left wing following Désiré Doué’s serious injury. The France international winger tore his right ACL on Saturday during PSG’s 3-2 away win over OGC Nice. A month ago, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia sustained a similar injury. Luis Enrique is adamant that Doué and Kvaratskhelia’s absences will be compensated by the quality of the team. “ Are we going to start crying and complaining? No, that’s not how a team operates .” The Spaniard trusts PSG to show their resilience and their focus in such testing circumstances, believing it will be a “ great challenge for everyone .” To alleviate the toll placed on their attacking players, PSG could be tempted to scour the market for a winger, but Luis Enrique said the club has no intention to sign for just six months. “ It’s not our style. With these players, this staff, this club, these fans, we remain confident that we can do our job well and overcome these difficulties .” PSG host Gian Piero Gasperini’s AS Roma at Paris’ Parc des Princes for Matchday 5 of the UEFA Champions League on Wednesday. GFFN | Bastien Cheval
summary_en: Désiré Doué tore his right ACL against Nice, and Luis Enrique rules out a stop-gap January signing.
